attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The name assistive technology reads for the icon.

attributes.name: live
attributes.description: `false` for a static page banner: no role=alert/status and no aria-live, so it is not announced when the page loads. Keep the default (true) for messages that appear in response to something.

tags.name: ui-announcer
tags.description: Announces its text to screen readers whenever the text changes, without showing anything.

attributes.name: show-menu-button
attributes.description: Show the menu button; `narrow` shows it only at 980px and below, where ui-layout uses its drawer.

attributes.name: bytes
attributes.description: File size in bytes, shown formatted.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Replaces the kind, size and state line. Put an error's reason here.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: The card opens this file.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: File name; also picks the icon from its extension.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: 0-100 while uploading; without it the bar is indeterminate.

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Shows a remove button (named "Remove <name>" unless removeLabel is set).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: MIME type, for the icon.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: `brand` uses the theme's primary colour (as on Badge).

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Defaults to the enclosing Message side.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the bubble a link (a suggestion).

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes it a link that looks like a button (a real <a>: new tab, address on hover, announced as a link). Goes through NavigationProvider like Sidebar and Breadcrumb links.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: `outline`, `soft` and `surface` are the same looks as the `recipe` of that name (in the accent colour, or the `tone`); `link` looks like a text link.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Passed to child buttons that set no size.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: The title's heading level (default 3), to fit the page's outline.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale for numbers (`en-IN` gives 1,00,000). Defaults to the nearest `lang` attribute, then the browser.

attributes.name: show-change
attributes.description: `false` for categories (stages, devices) rather than a sequence: shows the lowest value instead of a first-to-last change.

attributes.name: show-insight
attributes.description: The one-line readout under the plot (range and change, or the selected point). Defaults to `showSummary`.

attributes.name: show-summary
attributes.description: The Total / Average / Peak / Change row, and (unless `showInsight` says otherwise) the readout line under the plot.

attributes.name: show-table
attributes.description: Show the chart's numbers as a table below it (always available to screen readers).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected value. With onChange/onSelect it is controlled: a pick the parent rejects is undone.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Plain-text rows instead of children.

attributes.name: label-width
attributes.description: Width of the label column (a CSS length; a number is px). Default 10rem.

attributes.name: hidden-columns
attributes.description: Columns to hide, by key (`data-key` or header text) or 0-based index.

attributes.name: server-side
attributes.description: The rows passed in are the current page, already sorted and filtered by the server: the table shows them as they are and still reports sort, filter and page changes for you to fetch the next set. Use with `totalRows`.

attributes.name: total-rows
attributes.description: With `serverSide`: the number of rows in the whole result, for the summary and paging.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Which trigger edge the menu lines up with. Unset: the start edge, or the end edge when the menu would otherwise run off the window.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: `plain`: no box of its own (inside a Card, table or panel that already draws one).

attributes.name: auto-summary
attributes.description: A parent's dates follow its children (the earliest start to the latest end), and so does its progress when it has none of its own.

attributes.name: cascade
attributes.description: Moving a parent moves everything under it by the same days (a read-only task stays put). Makes parent bars draggable.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: The task list's columns, in order. The name column is always first. Default: name, owner, dates, progress.

attributes.name: creatable
attributes.description: Show a "+ Add task" button and let a double-click on empty timeline space ask for a task (`onTaskCreate`). Off in a `readonly` chart.

attributes.name: critical-path
attributes.description: Mark the critical path from the links: the tasks with no slack on a tight chain of links (a task you flag `critical` stays).

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fill the height of the container (which must have one): the toolbar keeps its height and the chart scrolls inside the rest.

attributes.name: grid-width
attributes.description: Width of the task list in px. The user can also drag the splitter; see `onGridResize`.

attributes.name: holidays
attributes.description: Dates that are not working days: `'YYYY-MM-DD'` strings, `Date`s, or `{ date, label }`. Shaded apart from `nonWorkingDays`, and the label names them in the day header.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Translations: any subset of the labels.

attributes.name: linkable
attributes.description: Show a dot beside each bar that you can drag onto another bar to ask for a dependency (`onLinkCreate`). Off in a `readonly` chart.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: BCP 47 locale for dates (month names, date formats, the week's first day). Defaults to the browser's.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Cap on the chart's height when it is not `fill`: a number (px) or a plain CSS length (`'60vh'`, `'none'`). Default 620px.

attributes.name: non-working-days
attributes.description: Weekdays that are not working days (0 is Sunday), or `'weekend'` for Saturday and Sunday. Shaded behind the rows where a day is wide enough to read.

attributes.name: schedule
attributes.description: How dependencies are enforced: `'warn'` (the default) draws a link whose target is too early in the danger style, `'auto'` also pushes the tasks that follow a task that moves (later only, keeping their length), `'off'` does neither.

attributes.name: snap
attributes.description: How far a drag snaps: to whole `'day'`s (the default), `'week'`s or `'month'`s. Arrow keys still move a day at a time.

attributes.name: week-start
attributes.description: First day of the week in the time header, as `Date#getDay` numbers it (0 is Sunday). Defaults to the locale's.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Outline level (default 2); also sets the default size.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Visual size, independent of the level.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the control inside.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Marks the group and its control invalid.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the media and text one link; actions stay separate.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The title (or use a slot="title" child).

attributes.name: drawer-breakpoint
attributes.description: Viewport width (px) at and below which the drawer is used. Default 980.

attributes.name: inset
attributes.description: variant="shell" only: header and sidebar on a tinted canvas, the content on a raised card. Pair with Sidebar variant="inset".

attributes.name: mobile-sidebar
attributes.description: Narrow screens: `drawer` turns the sidebar into an off-canvas drawer with a backdrop, opened by AppHeader's menu button or `sidebarOpen`; `stack` puts it above the content. Defaults to `drawer` for variant="shell" and `stack` otherwise.

attributes.name: sidebar-open
attributes.description: The drawer is open. With onSidebarOpenChange it is controlled.

attributes.name: live
attributes.description: A status whose text changes are announced.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: end for the current user.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: Machine-readable time.

attributes.name: grouped
attributes.description: A follow-up from the same sender: no repeated avatar or header.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Sender, shown and used to name the message.

attributes.name: time
attributes.description: Shown as given.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Hold screen-reader announcements while a reply streams.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Names the scrollable region (default "Messages").

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: With onValueChange the field is controlled: a committed value the parent rejects is undone.

attributes.name: href-template
attributes.description: Render the page controls as links: `?page={page}` (any URL with `{page}`). Each link can be opened in a new tab; a normal click goes through onNavigate / NavigationProvider.

attributes.name: allow-other
attributes.description: A free text answer beside the options.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The answer key.

attributes.name: when
attributes.description: "name:value": only asked when that earlier answer is or includes value.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: Show the slot="complete" content instead of the questions.

attributes.name: progress-label
attributes.description: "Question {current} of {total}"

attributes.name: shortcuts
attributes.description: 1-9 pick a choice and Enter goes on.

attributes.name: collapse-button
attributes.description: With `collapsible`: a chevron button in the header row that collapses / expands the sidebar.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Controlled: the sidebar is collapsed while this is true. Update it from `onCollapseChange`, or the collapse button and responsive collapsing will be undone on your next change of this prop.

attributes.name: item-gap
attributes.description: Space between an item's icon, label and badge.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: `dual`: the top-level items become an icon rail and the open one's `children` fill a panel beside it (as in Slack or Supabase). `collapsed` then hides the panel and keeps the rail; `width` sizes the panel. Put a logo or avatar on the rail with `Sidebar.RailStart` / `Sidebar.RailEnd`.

attributes.name: row-gap
attributes.description: Space between rows (default 8px).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Look: `inset` (with Layout inset), `indicator` (a brand bar on the current item), `pill`, `solid` (the current item filled with the brand colour), `gradient` (deep brand gradient), `glass` (frosted, for a photo or gradient behind it), `contrast` (dark), `minimal`, `split`, `surface`, `soft`, `floating`.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Sortables with the same group can exchange items: drop a card on another one and both report it (`change`'s `external`). Ids must be unique across the group.

attributes.name: list-max-height
attributes.description: The tallest the cards of a list can be before the list scrolls on its own: a number of px or a CSS length such as "20rem". A list's own `maxHeight` overrides it.

attributes.name: page-styles
attributes.description: renderItem / renderListHeader content is drawn inside the sortable's shadow root, where your CSS classes do not reach. `pageStyles` lets the page's stylesheets style it (they never override the sortable's own look).

attributes.name: touch-hold-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds a finger must rest on a card before it lifts (touch, dragging by the card). 0 lifts at once. Default 350.

attributes.name: decorative
attributes.description: Hide it from assistive technology when the surrounding control already says it is busy.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What is loading, read by screen readers (default "Loading").

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: A named size or a CSS length (a number is px).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: An Editora icon name ("wallet"), or your own element.

attributes.name: lines
attributes.description: Clamp to this many lines.

attributes.name: counter
attributes.description: Same as showCount, named like Input's prop.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Names the list ("Agent activity").

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Secondary text: a duration, a count, a diff stat.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What happened, as a sentence ("Failed to run pnpm build").

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Expanded (when it has children). Controlled with onOpenChange; omit for uncontrolled.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Unset means done.
